evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet configuration, transaction creation, fee bumping, and spend routines across src/wallet/.
rationale: Fixes #29220 where `-maxtxfee` was ambiguously conflated as both an absolute fee cap and a fee rate limit. Adding an independent `-maxfeerate` configuration option gives wallet users precise, durable protection against excessive fee rates without improperly capping total transaction size.
